liftoff_note: Flight 15 has flown. Actual liftoff 13 Nov 2026, 22:47:36 UTC (14 Nov 2026, 9:47:36 am AEDT). The pre-launch 75-minute window opened at 22:45:00 UTC.

webcast.label: SpaceX official webcast
webcast.melbourne_nominal: Flown — see the catch video on the launch monitoring page and the official SpaceX Flight 15 page.

schedule_source.title: NASASpaceflight — Starship Flight 15 Stream Schedule (subject to change)
schedule_source.note: UTC times as published; Melbourne AEDT = UTC+11; Starbase CST = UTC−6.

flight_complete_note: Flight 15 is complete. Planned booster catch at T+6:35 did not occur (catch aborted, FTS offshore). Ship caught at T+22:32:34 (Sun 15 Nov 2026, 8:20 am AEDT).

catch_milestones.label: Booster catch (planned)
catch_milestones.detail: T+6:35 — did not occur; catch aborted, booster lost offshore

catch_milestones.label: Ship catch (actual)
catch_milestones.detail: T+22:32:34 — Sun 15 Nov 2026, 8:20 am AEDT (first upper-stage catch)

catch_video.title: SpaceX Catches Starship for the First Time Ending Flight Test 15
catch_video.event: First tower catch of a Starship upper stage
